AdminAuthenticationKind.description:
How an admin request was authenticated.

A service credential presents an ``Authorization: Bearer agk_...`` header; a
human browser session presents the server-managed session cookie; a human CLI
session presents an ``Authorization: Bearer ags_...`` header established
through the OAuth device flow. All three resolve to the same
:class:`~aethergate.domain.entities.AdminRequestContext` and the same
centralized RBAC engine, but browser/CLI sessions carry no API credential.
AdminAuthenticationKind.title: AdminAuthenticationKind

ApiCredentialRead.description: Credential metadata; never the raw key or its verifier/hash.
ApiCredentialRead.title: ApiCredentialRead

AuditEventRead.description:
Safe immutable administrative audit event (never secret-bearing metadata).

``project_id`` is ``None`` for deployment-scoped events; only a ``system_admin``
may read those. ``metadata`` carries safe non-secret fields only.
AuditEventRead.title: AuditEventRead

BudgetReservationState.description: Lifecycle of a single per-request monetary budget reservation.
BudgetReservationState.title: BudgetReservationState

CancelResult.description:
Result of a safe request cancellation.

``result`` is one of ``cancelled_now``, ``cancellation_requested``, or
``already_cancelled``. A terminal-state request and an ``outcome_unknown``
request return ``409 invalid_transition`` rather than a result.
CancelResult.title: CancelResult

ChatCompletionRequest.description:
Pinned Chat Completions request surface.

Unknown additive fields are ignored; transport/provider-control fields are
explicitly rejected (they are never honored and never forwarded).
ChatCompletionRequest.title: ChatCompletionRequest

ChatMessage.description: A single chat message. Multimodal/tool payloads are unsupported and rejected.
ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage

CliSessionRead.description: Current human CLI session metadata. Never includes the raw session token.
CliSessionRead.title: CliSessionRead

CredentialAudience.description: Which surface a scoped API credential may authenticate against.
CredentialAudience.title: CredentialAudience

CredentialScope.description:
Granular permission scopes carried by a credential.

Inference credentials carry only ``inference:invoke``; admin credentials
carry only ``admin:*`` permission scopes. The enum is extensible so future
resource scopes can be added without replacing the credential model. The
``admin:*`` values double as the typed administrative permission names
checked by the RBAC authorization service.
CredentialScope.title: CredentialScope

DeviceAuthorizationRead.description:
Result of ``device/start``: the one-time device code and display values.

``device_code`` is a bearer secret returned exactly once here and never
persisted beyond its one-way SHA-256 verifier. ``user_code`` and the
verification URIs are non-secret display values.
DeviceAuthorizationRead.title: DeviceAuthorizationRead

DevicePollRead.description:
One device-flow poll outcome.

``status`` is ``pending``, ``slow_down``, or ``success``. Only ``success``
carries the freshly established ``session`` and the one-time raw ``token``
(returned exactly once, never persisted beyond its one-way SHA-256 verifier).
DevicePollRead.title: DevicePollRead

DevicePollRequest.description: A poll request carrying the one-time device code (never echoed back).
DevicePollRequest.title: DevicePollRequest

EndpointRuntimeRead.description:
Runtime/slot status for one endpoint (deployment-scoped).

``operational_state`` is the durable scheduler/operator state
(``active``/``paused``/``draining``), distinct from catalog ``is_active``.
EndpointRuntimeRead.title: EndpointRuntimeRead

LedgerEntryType.description:
The type of an append-only monetary ledger entry.

A ledger entry is either a priced measured-usage debit (backed by a
``UsageRecord``) or an explicit adjustment credit/debit (no usage record).
It is an accounting/event primitive, not a mandatory prepaid balance.
LedgerEntryType.title: LedgerEntryType

PriceSnapshotRead.description:
Immutable captured price at a dispatch decision (read-only historical).

Never exposes prompt/completion/provider-secret content; it is route/catalog
pricing history, not project-owned accounting data.
PriceSnapshotRead.title: PriceSnapshotRead

QueueRequestRead.description:
Safe queue request metadata (never prompt/completion/stream content).

Explicitly omits ``payload_encrypted``, ``result_encrypted``, stream-event
bodies, ``fencing_token``, and any provider secret material.
QueueRequestRead.title: QueueRequestRead

QueueSummaryRead.description: Side-effect-free operational counts for the caller's authorized scope.
QueueSummaryRead.title: QueueSummaryRead

QuotaMetric.description: The unit of a shared quota limit.
QuotaMetric.title: QuotaMetric

QuotaStatusRead.description:
Runtime provider-quota status for one limit (deployment-scoped).

A read never fabricates a ``QuotaWindow`` row; absent current window reports
zero committed/reserved. ``remaining_units = max(0, limit - committed -
reserved)``.
QuotaStatusRead.title: QuotaStatusRead

ResourceScopeType.description: The scope of a role assignment's authority.
ResourceScopeType.title: ResourceScopeType

Role.description:
Built-in administrative roles for the control plane.

``system_admin`` is deployment-wide; ``project_admin`` and ``project_viewer``
are scoped to exactly one project (their ``resource_id``). Custom-role CRUD
is deferred, but the model is designed so new roles can be added without a
rewrite of the authorization service.
Role.title: Role

SessionRead.description: Current human session metadata. Never includes session/csrf/oidc secrets.
SessionRead.title: SessionRead

WhoamiRead.description:
Safe admin identity metadata; never includes the raw key or hash.

Service-credential callers populate ``api_credential_id``/``audience``/
``scopes``; browser-session callers populate ``browser_session_id`` with
``authentication_kind=browser_session`` and empty/absent credential fields;
CLI-session callers populate ``cli_session_id`` with
``authentication_kind=cli_session`` and empty/absent credential fields.
WhoamiRead.title: WhoamiRead
